g.text: Monthly Census estimates of import shipments under $2,000 (HTS 9999.95), imports for consumption.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Measurement change: de minimis shipments (under $800) were not recorded before; part of the rise is newly recorded trade, not new imports.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: For scale: de minimis imports were $54.5bn in 2023, about $4.5bn a month (Fajgelbaum and Khandelwal, 2025), none of it in Census data.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, international trade (HTS 9999.95.0000 low-value estimates; Guide to Foreign Trade Statistics, sec. 2); EO 14256, EO 14324.
